description: Fountains or water features located along regional roads in the Brussels-Capital Region is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Inventory of fountains or water features located along regional roads in the Brussels-Capital Region. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Public space. Its keywords are art, Fountain, Water, Heritage, IFU. The portal shows 21 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
